term: per se link carried by a simultaneous event edge
definition: LinkOnSimultaneousEdge clock bearer C Link: if Link t y x then there are tokens e, f with C e f, bearer e = y, bearer f = x, clock e = t and clock f = t. Intended example: this exercise of the hand's moved stick pushing this stone, while the stick is being moved. Counterexample to the converse: a simultaneous edge from an unmoved source is no link. The relation is assumed neither transitive, asymmetric nor well-founded.
